title: Chapter 138 Return On Investment
content:
Chapter 138 Return On Investment

Wu Qing put a lot of thought into the development of the alliance territory and paid a price.

But it's all worth it. With the development and growth of each territory of the alliance, the system's Qi resources have been increasing at a faster rate in non-combat conditions.

Daxia Ling's basic luck is also increasing rapidly.

This is a change brought about by factors such as the karmic merits, fame and prestige, and world influence of Wu Qing, the Zerg, and the Daxia leader. In addition, there are also various changes caused by various intelligent creatures to Wu Qing and Wu Qing-related things. The influence of factors such as emotions.

These intangible and elusive things can bring luck to Wu Qing and increase the system's Qi resources.

Just like Wu Qing cultivated Hu Tu, supported the development of the alliance, supported the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, etc., as long as Hu Tu has achieved success, the alliance has grown stronger, and the Goblin Chamber of Commerce has improved its strength, Wu Qing will be able to reap huge fortune gains, and they will continue to gain. , it’s like an investment.

All of the above can be regarded as causal relationships, and they are causal relationships backed by a system that no one can rely on.

Wu Qing leads the Zerg race to fight against the invasion of evil gods and foreign races, rescues the refugees of local races, and other things that are conducive to the development of this world, can gain merit from this world, and allow the system to harvest Qi resources.

The fame and prestige brought by the Zerg in this world, the fame and prestige brought by Wu Qing's character, the love, hatred, respect, fear, joy, anger, sorrow, belief and disgust that friends and enemies have because of Wu Qing, the Zerg and the Daxia Territory. It can provide gas resources to the system.

Daxia leaders can also obtain corresponding basic luck within the scope of world rules.

These are all systematically guaranteed ways to obtain gas resources within the framework of world rules.

This is a long-term investment with long-term returns, in various ways, and Wu Qing needs to continue to explore and discover.

Therefore, in addition to developing the Zerg race, the most important thing for Wu Qing is to make more efforts in this world!

…

The things purchased by the Zerg in Alliance City from the goblin caravan were also transported back to the Daxia Territory by the Zerg parasites.

Among them, the books that Wu Qing valued most have been disposed of.

The books in this world are similar to those known to Wu Qing, except that the amount of information recorded in each of the purchased books is not large. Wu Qing did not find any long masterpieces in these books.

Wu Qing bought all the books in the goblin caravan. Once the books were obtained, the one-star host used his spiritual power to enter the information on all the books into the insect queen's data storage area in one night and recorded them.

The queen will sort out this information and store it in categories so that when needed, the required information can be found quickly.

Some of the important information will be sorted out and sent to Wu Qing through the Zerg information network for Wu Qing to know.

Once Wu Qing has obtained the information he needs, the books themselves are of little value to him. These books will be transported back to Daxia Territory together with other goods and temporarily kept as collections.

A large number of people and materials were transported back to Daxia Territory. After the last experience of large-scale personnel joining and material transportation, the people of Daxia Territory were used to it.

A population of nearly 10,000 people was registered and resettled by Hu Tu's organization. Many of these people were good at construction. After being resettled, they could be invested in the construction of the city.

Other commodities are stored in the underground warehouse of the new city of Daxia, and will be analyzed and studied by the insect queen to find out anything valuable.

…

Wu Qing's insect clones arrived in Daxia Territory early before the personnel and materials from Alliance Chongqing were transported back.

In the Daxia Territory where the morning sun was rising, what he saw was a bustling construction scene.

Thick and dense personnel are busy at the construction site, contributing to the construction of the city.

The new city in Daxia Territory has been constructed very quickly with a lot of manpower input and sufficient material support in the past few days.

The outer city walls, residential areas and urban core areas have all taken shape, and some areas of the most urgently needed residential areas can already accommodate people.

According to the current construction progress, all residents of Daxia Territory will have a place to live in a few days.

Wu Qing came to a temporary tent outside the city in a low-key manner without disturbing the busy leaders. He came here this time because there were some matters in the Daxia leader that he needed to deal with personally.

The first person to arrive was Hu Tu, who came with several Huaxian tribesmen and people who were familiar with agricultural production.

"I've met the lord!"

Hu Tu and everyone bowed respectfully to Wu Qing.

"No courtesy! Please sit down!"

Wu Qing sat on the main seat and asked everyone to sit down and talk.

Seeing that everyone was a little restrained, Wu Qing introduced the topic first.

"I have carefully read the report you jointly submitted on food security issues in the territory. You have made the problem very clear. I basically agree with several of your suggestions."

"The reason I'm here this time is to talk to you face to face and confirm some things so that you can come up with an executable implementation plan as soon as possible."

Because of their special status, petite stature, and only sixteen members of the Huaxian tribe, Hu Tu did not let them participate in building the city at that time, but arranged for them to take care of the food crops in the territory that had not been destroyed.

The sixteen Huaxian people enjoy full freedom in Daxia Territory, and because they all passed the examination of the Recruitment Center and obtained identity cards, they can be regarded as the management of the territory.

This unprecedented treatment made them enthusiastic and began to proactively plan for Daxia.

They used the function of the identity card to learn a lot from the Queen of Insects, and used the identity card to find some talents in the territory who were most familiar with agricultural production, and together they made suggestions for the most important food supply problem in the territory.

The Flower Fairy Clan itself is an expert in botany, and with several talents familiar with the food production and supply problems in the territory, after a period of field research, they took the report materials that Wu Qing saw.

Food is the first necessity of the people! This sentence is also true in this world!

If you can't even have enough food, everything else is empty talk.

This world is rich in wild resources. When the territory is small, you can still eat in the wild. When the territory develops to a certain scale, eating in the wild will not work.

Continuously eating in the wild will make the resources around the territory less and less. The more people in the territory, the faster the resources in the wild around the territory will decrease, and the larger the scope will be.

Eventually, the population of the territory will eat up all the nearby resources. This world is very dangerous if it is far away from the territory. It is very difficult to mine and transport resources far away. Unless the territory can be migrated like nomads, this model is unsustainable.

This is the case with the Great Xia Territory. After this period of wild gathering and hunting, the animal and plant resources around the Great Xia Territory have become less.
